title: Add RAG agent examples, tool-calling quickstarts, and docs site updates
author: Ava Patel
description: Context: Add a set of RAG templates, agent tool-calling quickstarts, and docs site updates to make it easier for engineers to get started with Retrieval-Augmented Generation and tool-calling in Redwood. Motivation: provide end-to-end examples (playbook, notebook, CLI) that illustrate best practices for prompt templates, retrieval configuration, and safe tool invocation. This PR implements new example projects in redwood-examples, new quickstart pages on the docs site, and small SDK snippet updates for Python and TypeScript. It also wires the new pages into the docs sidebar and adds integration tests for the playbook. Checklist: - [x] Add RAG templates (query, chunking, prompt templates) - [x] Add agent tool-calling quickstart (playbook example) - [x] Add lightweight CLI quickstart and notebook - [x] Docs: add quickstart pages, sidebar entries, and cross-links - [x] Update Python/TS SDK example snippets for the new agent API - [x] Add integration test and CI job - [x] Run lint and fix style issues Notes: Linear reference ENG-1423. The description below is a high-level summary rather than a file diff. See commits for details. CI: initial test run had a flaky integration failure on GPU-backed CI which was reproduced and fixed by increasing the test timeout and adding a small retry in the test harness. The docs deploy step was validated on the staging site. Migration/compat: no breaking runtime changes; SDK snippets are additive.
